𓈒   ˖.    **fempov fork**   ݁   ۪    ୧

*Lots of people asked for a FemPov fork of this bot, in the comments of the original, and it's been more than a year, so here you go. All credit to the original bot-maker, @kissesformilo.*

*Open to comments and suggestions for additional greetings or edits.*

**Update** Added new, non-NTR alt-greeting, by request.

⤷ *Aeson's known you for as long as he can remember, and you've had a place in his heart for just as long. He hasn't confessed his feelings to you yet, because he's happy in his relationship with you. You're his best friend in name, but you two might as well be lovers - that's how close you and him are. But then you went and got yourself a rich, pretty-boy boyfriend who he can't help feeling jealous of, because suddenly he's not allowed to do all the things he used to do with you. So, excuse him for being snappy and pushing boundaries, but he's not sorry. Not one fucking bit.*

ー、☆.  **Three Scenarios** *!*
⸝⸝ Scenario One ; *You bring your boyfriend with you to his band practice, and he greets you calling you 'baby' and kissing you on the lips in front you him.*
⸝⸝ Scenario Two ; *He wants you to do his eyeliner while sitting on his lap, claiming you have 'shaky hands'. But really, he wants to piss off your boyfriend, and have you close again like old times.*
⸝⸝ **New** Scenario Three ; *You arrive late to the band's practice, upset and having just broken up with your boyfriend, Ajax.*

Fork Notes:
-Minor edits and corrections, mostly for changing to FemPov, to reduce tokens, or to remove redundancies.
-Made him slightly shorter (in both ways), because kind of tired of male bots who are basketball-player tall with pornstar-sized pp's. 6'2" is still tall, and 7-inches is still way above average.
-Changed his eyes from red to grey, because nobody IRL has red eyes, except some rare albinos (and vampires, kek.)
-Changed him to the bass player instead of the guitarist, because in the picture, he's holding a bass guitar.
-Took out 'spitting in mouth' and 'asphyxiation' kinks... why does everyone always put these in? They're gross and scary, respectively. Oh well, LLM's almost never do anything with these anyways, even if they're in the definition.
-Added names and brief profiles for the other band members and Ajax, to try and make them 'more real' and not just fade into the background, and for consistency.
-Added a location as a run-down old house, rented and shared by the band members.
-Gave Aeson a job! Works in a warehouse, to barely cover his bills and buy weed.
-Edited 'Scenario' info to only include stuff which will always remain true, even in long chats, removing starter scenario stuff. (Scenario info gets refreshed continually, and can make the LLM get confused or 'revert'.)
-Added new, non-NTR greeting, by request.
